title: audit.logging config
description: Appears as blueprint.components[].config. The Selector fills entities from the writable blueprint entities. Maps to mortar.audit.

entities.description: Entities whose writes are recorded: URL segment under /api/ and the entity name stored. Omit read-only entities.

adminRole.description: The only role that may read /api/audit-logs, without the ROLE_ prefix. Maps to mortar.audit.admin-role.
